changeSet.author: newstrader
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE scenario_snapshots ( id SERIAL NOT NULL, analysis_id INTEGER NOT NULL, scenario_key VARCHAR(1) NOT NULL, ticker VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, is_future BOOLEAN NOT NULL, published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, provider VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, rules_version VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, raw JSON NOT NULL, plan JSON NOT NULL, eligible BOOLEAN NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (analysis_id, scenario_key) ); CREATE INDEX ix_scenario_snapshots_analysis_id ON scenario_snapshots (analysis_id);

changeSet.author: newstrader
newstrader
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE scenario_evaluations ( snapshot_id INTEGER NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, checked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, cursor_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, entry_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, entry_price FLOAT, exit_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, exit_price FLOAT, result_r FLOAT, detail TEXT NOT NULL, confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, market_context JSON NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_id), FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id) REFERENCES scenario_snapshots (id) );

changeSet.author: newstrader
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE scenario_events ( id SERIAL NOT NULL, snapshot_id INTEGER NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, recorded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, data JSON NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (snapshot_id, kind), FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id) REFERENCES scenario_snapshots (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_scenario_events_snapshot_id ON scenario_events (snapshot_id);

changeSet.author: newstrader
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE scenario_candles ( id SERIAL NOT NULL, ticker VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, is_future BOOLEAN NOT NULL, begin_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, end_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, data JSON NOT NULL, source VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, fetched_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (ticker, is_future, begin_at) );

changeSet.author: newstrader
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE scenario_subscriptions ( id SERIAL NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, snapshot_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channels JSON NOT NULL, kinds JSON NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, after_event_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (user_id, snapshot_id), FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), FOREIGN KEY(snapshot_id) REFERENCES scenario_snapshots (id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_scenario_subscriptions_user_id ON scenario_subscriptions (user_id);

changeSet.author: newstrader
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE scenario_deliveries ( id SERIAL NOT NULL, subscription_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, next_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, sent_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, error TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (subscription_id, event_id, channel), FOREIGN KEY(subscription_id) REFERENCES scenario_subscriptions (id), FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES scenario_events (id) );
